title: Understanding the Plot
text: Observe how the predictions of each model compare to the true observed values. Are the predictions close to the observed values?

title: Model Predictions
text: Look at the lines representing each model. Do they follow the trend of the observed data points?

title: Average Prediction Line
text: Consider the dotted line representing the average prediction. How does it compare to the observed data?

title: Model Bias
text: Do the models show high or low bias based on their predictions compared to the observed values?
